title: Coverage: SRH-consumed decap site (receive.rs:352-359) lacks a tunnel-with-RH3-inner test
description: Coverage follow-up from v1c2 (correctness reviewer): the v1c2 hardening added first-next-header-43 drops at BOTH decap sites in receive.rs, but the new integration test only drives site 1 (Absent/local-delivery path). Site 2 (SRH-consumed path, receive.rs:352-359 process_source_route advance branch) shares the same guard but needs its own test: build an outer with an SRH whose segments_left reaches 0 at the gateway/local hop, inner carrying first-NH 43, assert non-delivery. Mirror the site-1 test tunneled_inner_with_rh3_is_dropped_at_local_delivery.
